svg.title: The Tesseract software stack
svg.desc: Layered software stack, top to bottom: llama.cpp and PyTorch; the ggml-tesseract backend and tsr_rt; tsr_transport with the sim, mock, vkernel and xrt kinds; firmware on the RISC-V control core (runtime, graph executor, kernels for MUL_MAT, norms, RoPE and flash attention, selftest and replay); the NPU core (control core, issue path with unit queues, DMA, QACT, MVM clusters, vector unit, SPM); the Alveo U200 card with the XRT shell and four DDR4 channels. A column of developer tools sits beside the middle layers: bit-exact simulator, tsr-selftest, klcheck and numcheck, trace tools, tsr-log, and planned GDB debugging and profiler. Tags give each block's status: on the card (v1), on the simulator (v2) or planned; the xrt kind is planned because only the v1 transport has run on the card.
